Check that the shift lever cannot be shifted out of the P position when operated.
Check that the shift lever can be shifted out of the P position with the IG ON and the brake pedal depressed.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Shift Lock Release Button Operation

s2.ptxt: Check that the shift lever can be shifted out of the P position when operated while pressing the shift lock release button.

item.ptxt: Be sure to perform this after inspecting and adjusting the engine.
Perform at normal operating fluid temperature (50 to 80°C).
Perform the test with the A/C OFF.

s2.ptxt: Apply the parking brake and chock the wheels.
Start the engine.
While depressing the brake pedal, shift from the N position to the D or R position at idle speed, and measure the time until a slight shock is felt.

specitem.ptxt: N → D position 1.2 seconds or less
N → R position 1.5 seconds or less

item.ptxt: Take several measurements and use the average value.
When measuring repeatedly, allow an interval of 1 minutes.
Be sure to perform this after inspecting and adjusting the engine.
Perform at normal operating fluid temperature (50 to 80°C).
Perform the test with the A/C OFF.
Do not continuously run the test for 5 seconds or more.
Perform the test in a place with a high μ (coefficient of friction), such as on asphalt, so that the tires do not spin.

s2.ptxt: Apply the parking brake and chock the wheels.
Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, display the [ECU Data Monitor] screen and select [Engine Speed].
Firmly depress the brake pedal with your left foot, shift to the D position, fully depress the accelerator pedal with your right foot, and quickly read the highest engine speed.

item.ptxt: Before and after measurement, clean the gauges and hoses with white gasoline or equivalent.
Be sure to perform this after inspecting and adjusting the engine.
Perform at normal operating fluid temperature (50 to 80°C).
Perform the test with the A/C OFF.
Do not continuously run the stall test for 5 seconds or more.

atten4.ptxt: If there is an open or short in the line pressure control solenoid assembly circuit, the line pressure becomes maximum.

s2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, display the [ECU Data Monitor] screen and select [Engine Speed].
Remove the test plug, install the automatic transmission oil pressure gauge and adapter C, and start the engine.
Apply the parking brake and chock the wheels.
Firmly depress the brake pedal and shift to the D position.
Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, display the [Active Test] screen and select 3 gear in [ECT Shift Position].
Measure the line pressure at idle speed.
Stop the engine.
Disconnect the transmission control computer connector.

atten4.ptxt: The transmission control computer connector is disconnected only during the D position stall test.

s2.ptxt: Start the engine.
Firmly depress the brake pedal and shift to the D position.
Depress the accelerator pedal and measure the line pressure during the stall test.
Stop the engine.
Connect the transmission control computer connector.
Firmly depress the brake pedal and shift to the R position.
Depress the accelerator pedal and measure the line pressure during the stall test.
Remove the automatic transmission oil pressure gauge and adapter C, and install the test plug
Using SST (TaSCAN), clear the DTCs by following the instructions on the screen (see ).

item.ptxt: Be sure to perform this after inspecting and adjusting the engine.
Perform at normal operating fluid temperature (50 to 80°C).
Perform with the A/C and cruise control OFF.
When 1 or 3 gear is output and the fluid temperature is less than -25°C, shifting to 2 gear and 4, 5 and 6 gears is not possible.
When 1 - 4 gear is output and the fluid temperature is -25°C or more and less than 0°C, or 51km/h or less, shifting to 5 and 6 gears is not possible.
Lock-up control is not entered when the engine coolant temperature is 60°C or less or the stop light switch is ON.
Acceleration flex lock-up control is not entered when the fluid temperature is 40°C or less or 110°C or more, or the stop light switch is ON.
Deceleration flex lock-up control is not entered when the fluid temperature is 20°C or less or 110°C or more.
Vehicle speeds at or above the top speed fuel cut speed cannot be reached, so these are reference values.
*1: 1 → 3 shift
*2: 3 → 1 shift

atten2.ptxt: Make sure that the road is safe before performing the test.

item.ptxt: Be sure to perform this after inspecting and adjusting the engine.
Perform at normal operating fluid temperature (50 to 80°C).
Perform with the A/C and cruise control OFF.

entry.ptxt: Check that the transmission shifts 1st ←→ 2nd ←→ 3rd ←→ 4th ←→ 5th ←→ 6th during normal driving (typical city driving).
Transmission Control Switch Operation (D ←→ S Selector Switch Operation)
In the 6 gear speed range, operate the shift lever between the D position and S position, and check that the transmission shifts between 6 and 4 gear.
Shift Shock Level when Driving in D Position
During normal driving, check the shock level at each upshift.
With the vehicle stopped, check that the range changes 1 range ←→ 2 range ←→ 3 range ←→ 4 range ←→ 5 range ←→ 6 range (meter display) when "+" and "-" are operated in the S position.

item.ptxt: Perform kick-down in each gear and check that the transmission downshifts.
Check the shock level during kick-down.
While driving in 6 gear in the S position (6 range) (approximately 70 to 80km/h), shift to "-" on the sequential gate and check engine braking in 5 gear.
While driving in 5 gear in the S position (5 range) (approximately 55 to 65km/h), shift to "-" on the sequential gate and check engine braking in 4 gear.
While driving in 4 gear in the S position (4 range) (approximately 30 to 40km/h), shift to "-" on the sequential gate and check engine braking in 3 gear.
While driving in 3 gear in the S position (3 range) (approximately 20 to 30km/h), shift to "-" on the sequential gate and check engine braking in 2 gear.
While driving in 2 gear in the S position (2 range) (approximately 10 to 20km/h), shift to "-" on the sequential gate and check engine braking in 1 gear.

entry.ptxt: Start off in the D position with the accelerator pedal fully depressed, and check that the upshift speed from 1 to 2 gear matches the shift point.
While driving at a constant speed in the lock-up speed range on a level road, lightly depress the accelerator pedal and check that the engine speed does not change greatly.
Stop the vehicle on a slope (approximately 5° or more), shift to the P position, and check that the vehicle does not move when the parking brake is released.
Check for abnormal noise and vibration while driving and during shifting.

item.ptxt: Check that upshifting to 6 gear or to 5 gear or higher is prohibited when climbing a slope in the D position.
Check that the transmission automatically downshifts to 5, 4 or 3 gear when the brakes are applied while descending a slope in the D position.

entry.ptxt: After the road test, check each part for oil leaks.
